n: VEX V5 Workcell and CTE Workcell
t: A desktop sized industrial robot arm model built from VEX V5 parts.
steps: Find the V5 Workcell or CTE Workcell on the VEX site.
Ask IT to install VEXcode V5.
Follow the build instructions to assemble the arm.
Test the bumper switch emergency stop.
Note that the V5 Workcell STEM Labs were reported as archived.
